name: Freeze Dried Fruit Powder
seoTitle: Freeze Dried Fruit Powder | Sheer Superfood
description: Sheersuperfood is fruit powder manufacturer and wholesale supplier, offering over 20 standard varieties and customization services. Our Class 100,000 cleanroom facility ensures batch testing, stable production capacity, and supports bulk orders and sample testing. Freeze-dried fruit powders are pure natural powder products made from whole fresh fruits (including pulp, peel, and seeds) processed through vacuum freeze-drying technology. Process Features: Frozen at -30°C to -50°C, then dehydrated via vacuum sublimation. No high temperatures are used throughout, fully preserving the fruit's nutrients and flavor. Core Advantages: 100% pure fruit powder with no additives or carriers. Retains dietary fiber, natural color, and rich fruit aroma. Ideal for baking, solid beverages, chocolate, and functional foods.
